What is the x-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.stimulus:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = -3x - 8
y = 3x - 2
problem.question: What is the x-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 우변이 같으므로 -3x - 8 = 3x - 2이다. 양변에서 정리하면 (-6)x = 6이므로 x = 6 ÷ (-6) = -1이다. 이를 y = -3x - 8에 대입하면 y = -3 × -1 - 8 = -5이다. 따라서 x좌표는 -1이다.
problem.explanationEn: Since the right-hand sides are equal, -3x - 8 = 3x - 2. Rearranging gives (-6)x = 6, so x = 6 ÷ (-6) = -1. Substituting into y = -3x - 8 gives y = -3 × -1 - 8 = -5. So the x-coordinate is -1.
